summary: Vault content stays encrypted after execution, except that an encrypted file used as src for copy, template, unarchive, script or assemble is decrypted on the target host, by design.
questions: Will my vault-encrypted config file be decrypted when copied to servers?
Does the copy module decrypt vault files on the target?
Which modules decrypt vault files on the remote host?

answer_card.title: When encrypted files are decrypted on targets
answer_card.answer_md: Vault content normally stays encrypted. The exception: if an encrypted file is the `src` for **copy, template, unarchive, script or assemble**, it is written **decrypted** on the target (given the correct password). This is intentional so you can keep config files encrypted in your repo while servers get usable plaintext.
